# Byrd Polar and Climate Research Center

> The Byrd Polar and Climate Research Center at Ohio State University conducts cutting-edge research on polar regions, climate dynamics, glaciology, and environmental geochemistry with partnerships across NASA, NOAA, and the National Science Foundation.

Based at Scott Hall on the Ohio State University campus, the Byrd Center houses multiple research groups studying Antarctica, Greenland, and climate systems through field expeditions, computational modeling, and public engagement initiatives. The center maintains specialized facilities including the Goldthwait Polar Library and Polar Rock Repository.

## Key Topics

- Polar Research
- Climate Science
- Antarctica
- Greenland
- Glacier Dynamics
- Climate Analytics
- Earth Systems Modeling
- Environmental Geochemistry
- Paleoclimatology
- Ice Sheets and Sea-Level Rise
- Climate Change
- Education and Outreach
- Polar Rock Repository
- POLENET: The Polar Earth Observing Network
- National Science Foundation

## Core Research Groups

- [Research Groups Overview](https://byrd.osu.edu/research/groups): Listing of research groups including Climate Analytics and Earth Systems Modeling
- [Earth Systems Modeling](https://byrd.osu.edu/research/groups/earth-systems-modeling): Earth Systems Modeling group led by Zhengyu Liu on climate dynamics and projections
- [Glacier Dynamics Research Group](https://byrd.osu.edu/research/groups/glacier-dynamics): Glacier Dynamics group studying ice sheets, sea-level rise, and ice flow modeling
- [Environmental Geochemistry](https://byrd.osu.edu/research/groups/environmental-geochemistry): Environmental Geochemistry group led by W. Berry Lyons studying Antarctic polar research
- [Geological Sciences](https://byrd.osu.edu/research/groups/geology): Geological Sciences research on Antarctica paleoclimate and glaciation history
- [Climate Analytics](https://byrd.osu.edu/research/groups/climate-analytics/projects): Climate Analytics group projects on drought monitoring and storm impact modeling
- [Education and Engagement](https://byrd.osu.edu/research/groups/education-outreach): Education and Engagement group with NASA and NOAA partnerships for public outreach

## Research Projects and Initiatives

- [Research Overview](https://byrd.osu.edu/research): Overview of research groups, facilities, and polar/climate science initiatives
- [Climate Analytics Research Projects](https://byrd.osu.edu/research/groups/climate-analytics/projects): Climate Analytics group projects on drought monitoring and storm impact modeling
- [Environmental Geochemistry Projects](https://byrd.osu.edu/research/groups/environmental-geochemistry/research): Antarctic research on iron bioavailability and subglacial lake geochemistry
- [Education and Engagement Projects](https://byrd.osu.edu/research/groups/education-outreach/education-and-engagement-projects): Community engagement projects on climate education and environmental monitoring

## Publications and Research Output

- [Earth Systems Modeling Publications](https://byrd.osu.edu/research/groups/earth-systems-modeling/publications): Publications on paleoclimate, monsoon hydroclimate, and glacial dynamics research
- [Climate Analytics Publications](https://byrd.osu.edu/research/groups/climate-analytics/publications): Peer-reviewed publications from Climate Analytics on hydrometeorology and drought
- [Environmental Geochemistry Publications](https://byrd.osu.edu/research/groups/environmental-geochemistry/publications): Publications on Antarctica glacial chemistry and subglacial brines research
